main_text.p: permotus,pro Sodomitis jamjam perituris ferió & suppliciter intercesit:Gen.18.

Atqui cum etiam Judex mundi Deus sit, & ruina interituq; impiorum hominum, gloriam justiciæ judicijq; divini illustra-ri & sanciri plurimū interfit, ne ἐπιφθό[?]-μον Deum, & misericordem solùm, non aute justum, agnoscere videretur, sic pro illis intercedendum erat viro sancto, ut tamen id demum fieri vellet, quod apud semetipsum jam constituisset Dominus, seruoq; suo familiariter aperverat. Videmus ut interdum in judicio de Deo deerret etiam religiosa mens, cum nonnihil subveretur, ne sic Deus justiciam suam declaret,ut interim misericordiæ obliui-scatur.

Videamus autem,quomodo etiam pij homines in judicio de seipsis & alijs hallucinentur. Recusant, Moses gubernati-onem Jsraelitici populi: Jeremias munus propheticum: uterque infantiæ &infir-mitatis suæ conscientiam allegat. Samu-el,cum ex Jsai filijs Rex eligendus esset,à natu maximo initium fecit,minimū natu illis præferendum esse, minimè, ut appa-ret, suspicatus. Sed Deus,quid de uno-

page.notes: The Greek word after "ne" is printed across a line end with a hyphen; the letters after the first syllable are uncertain, marked [?]. The word after "fanc" in "sancto" is a ligature, read as "sancto". "aperverat" and "subveretur" are read with v as consonant per the orthography rule. Long s is plain s throughout. Initial I as consonant is J (Judex, Jeremias, Jsai, Jsraelitici); the running head is JONAE. The printed catchword "quoq;" appears at the right foot.
